text:
maria: Quick sync  Saturn Health requested a 3-part enablement series (intro, integration lab, live Q&A). Proposing regional slots: Tue 10:00 PT / Wed 18:00 CET / Thu 09:00 SGT. Who can cover which slot? cc @leo @sasha
leo: I can cover Tue 10:00 PT. I'll do runtime + production best practices and a quick 5-min cost tips section. :thumbsup:
sasha: I can do Tue PT and Thu SGT. I'll own the integration lab and troubleshooting checklist.
jordan: Saturn here. Wed 18:00 CET is the best for our EMEA engineers. Please include a migration checklist for saturn-staging -> saturn-prod and a short KMS/data-privacy sign-off for our security team. Also need a Zoom link.
maria: Draft agenda per region (95m total):
```
1) 00-05m intro & goals
2) 05-35m architecture + best practices
3) 35-80m hands-on lab (staging -> prod demo)
4) 80-95m Q&A & next steps
```
Any additions?
leo: Add a 5-min "quick wins" right after best practices (token/cost tips).
sasha: Requesting prework: API key, staging access, and one example prompt set. I'll attach the lab repo to the calendar invite.
jordan: We'll send prework by EOD Monday. Also flagging a renewal touchpoint in ~6 weeks; if adoption is slow they may ask to revisit terms.
maria: I'll schedule a week+2 post-workshop 1:1 to check adoption and add a renewal health note in the account.
calendar-bot: Created event "Saturn Health Enablement - EMEA" for 2025-09-10 18:00 CET. Invitees: maria, leo, sasha, jordan. Link: https://zoom.redwood.example/meet/abc123
maria: Thanks bot. @sasha can you attach the lab repo + runbook to the invite? I'll post a short prework template and feedback survey after each session.
sasha: Repo: https://git.redwood/saturn-onboard. Runbook attached by tomorrow AM.
jordan: Can you include a KMS/data-privacy checklist our security lead can sign off before prod cutover?
maria: Adding a "Security sign-off" checkbox in the prework doc and calendar notes.
leo: I'll prepare a 5-slide demo on caching & prefix-KV with perf metrics and a tiny sample config snippet.
maria: If no objections I'll lock the three regional slots by EOD and send the prework template + calendar attachments. :rocket:
jordan: Confirmed. Thanks!
leo: :thumbsup:
sasha: :white_check_mark:
maria: Closing loop  invites sent, prework template posted, runbook pinned in the event, follow-ups scheduled.
